title: INU
description:
INU is animated licking doge screenmate application.Feature• Simple sprite animation.

• Random-moving on screen, as top level window always.

• Support Windows 11 and Windows 10 (need for DirectX 12, Feature level 12_0).
CommandLine OptionUsage:
inu.exe [quantity] [gaben]

Option:
quantity: Much INU (1-666).
gaben: Such easter egg.

INU Properties > GENERAL > LAUNCH OPTIONS
How to exitClick the INU icon on taskbar-corner.
If you see of the following windowUnfortunately, your computer can't execute for INU application, let's uninstall and post much humorous review!
